description: The PICO agent's num_ctx and stop, Python and Rust alike (#640, #641, #642). Each case runs the real agent, the real map-reduce and a real client over a fake Ollama transport. A JSON-mode request is answered with `json_reply` (it reads as both a suitability check and an extraction), a plain one with `digest`. `text` is `text_unit` repeated `text_repeat` times. With `stop_at_request` k (0-based) the stop is set as request k arrives, and that request then fails (`request_at_stop: fails`, a transport fault) or answers. `stop_before` sets it before the run. `expected.requests` is how many requests reached the transport, every one carrying the case's `num_ctx` (absent when null); `expected.error` is the error kind, or null for a result. `fn: prepare` is `prepare` alone; `fn: prepared` is `prepare`, then `check_suitability_prepared` and `extract_prepared`; at this budget a 60-unit text takes four condensation requests (four batches whose digests fit merged).
title: A trial
text_unit: Adults aged 40-65 were randomised to metformin or placebo.
digest: Adults aged 40-65 were randomised to metformin or placebo.

json_reply.rationale: An RCT of metformin against placebo.

cases.name: a whole paper's extraction carries num_ctx
a condensed paper: every condenser request and both calls carry num_ctx
a stop before the run sends nothing
a stop before a long paper's run sends nothing
a stop during a failing extraction request is stopped, not request_failed
a stop during an extraction request that answers returns the result
a stop during a failing condensation request sends no other
a stop during a condensation request that answers sends no other
a stop during a condensation request that answers fails prepare, never a partial digest
a stop during the last condensation request fails prepare
a stop after the condensation stops before the check
